objectives.text: This source is an index of FinCEN civil enforcement actions and serves as enforcement evidence of applied BSA/AML expectations; it does not itself establish operative program-establishment duties.

citations.quote: Under the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), 31 U.S.C. 5311 et seq., and its implementing regulations at 31 C.F.R. Chapter X (formerly 31 C.F.R. Part 103), FinCEN may bring an enforcement action for violations of the reporting, recordkeeping, or other requirements of the BSA.

interactions.text: The index enumerates specific matters (matter numbers and dates) against in-scope actor types — Depository Institutions, Money Services Businesses, and Securities and Futures — as applied-expectation evidence. Examples include In the Matter of Canaccord Genuity LLC (2026-01, Securities and Futures), In the Matter of TD Bank, N.A. and TD Bank USA, N.A. (2024-02, Depository Institutions), and Paxful, Inc. and Paxful USA, Inc. (2025-02, Money Services Businesses). Out-of-scope sectors (Casinos, Insurance, Precious Metals/Jewelry, Mortgage) also appear and are boundary regimes.

notes: CEILING APPLIED: This source is enforcement_evidence and may not establish operative duties, so no obligations were extracted; the regulatory citations (registration, CTR/SAR/FBAR reporting, recordkeeping) and enumerated matters are recorded as interactions/definitions only. The page's citations point to reporting/recordkeeping and MSB-registration rules, but the substantive program-establishment ('pillars') duties are not stated in this index — they live in the cited regulations. SAR/CTR appear here but are scoped as coordination layer, and FBAR/casinos/precious-metals/insurance/mortgage are boundary regimes; extracted only as cross-references. The FINRA SRO layer and federal banking agency / SEC program rules are not addressed in this source. The financial-institution filter list (Casinos, Depository Institutions, Insurance Industry, Money Services Businesses, Mortgage Co/Broker, Precious Metals/Jewelry Industry, Securities and Futures) is a UI category set, not a definitional taxonomy; noted here rather than as defined terms. Ambiguity preserved: the index does not distinguish civil/criminal authority beyond 'civil money penalties' and lists some matters without an assigned financial-institution category.
